database_scope_note: DEB train and test share the same retail database. This evaluates new tasks on familiar data, not generalization to unseen databases.
forced_train: Every family with more than 4 final eligible candidate task IDs; count task IDs, not historical versions.
measurement_purpose: Stratification only; no training export of difficulty traces.
objective: For each observed category of each of the three dimensions, sum abs(number of candidate tasks in test category / total candidate tasks in category - 1/4). Category denominators count candidate tasks, not families and not test composition. Use exact rational arithmetic.
random_algorithm: Python random.Random(seed). First assign sorted entirely-noncandidate families using one random()<0.25 each. Then for each of exactly 10000 draws, visit sorted candidate-containing families: forced train consumes no random draw; otherwise random()<0.25 assigns entire family to test. Evaluate candidate categories only. Choose earliest draw attaining minimum exact objective.
success_definition: Native reward map satisfies its source success rule AND the qualified frozen task audit returns 1 on the actual same agent submission. Native-only counts retained separately. Missing audit or invalid execution is not a success and does not silently become a measured failure.
tie_breaker: first minimum in draw order; no secondary metric or seed search
unit: family-V1 task_family; all members including noncandidates stay together

workflow_rules.normalization: lowercase, trim, replace spaces with underscores
